subtitle: Mobile & Agentic Systems
summary: Product engineer and systems thinker who ships AI-powered products end-to-end. 12+ years building mobile apps used by 1M+ people; now designing LLM features on the Claude API and orchestrating agentic development with Claude Code. I own problems, not tickets — and I'm ready to lead or mentor AI adoption in a team. Recharged after a break and ready for new challenges.

jobs.role: Personal project · product owner & process architect
points: Shipped an LLM chat that answers strictly from CV data: Claude API streaming, prompt caching, grounding and prompt-injection guardrails; production golden check 12/12.
Architected a page agent on the same chat: the model controls the site through typed, WebMCP-ready tools, with human-in-the-loop confirmation for external actions.
Designed a multi-agent workflow — orchestrator in Linear, up to 3 parallel sessions, strict file ownership, CI as arbiter — packaged as a reusable ai-dev-kit template.
13 tickets, 14 sessions, ~263 automated tests with zero real LLM calls in CI; abuse and cost control by design ($10/mo hard cap).
Owned delivery of key features for Cync and August Home smart-home apps, each serving 1M+ users: BLE device discovery, status sync, offline resilience.
Developed white-label self-service kiosk and POS apps for restaurants and cafes.

Consolidated 200+ color resources into the design system across 8 white-label projects (10+ modules each) with AI-assisted refactoring and manual review — 3 days vs. ~2 weeks; simplified dark mode and unified the UI.
Built complex custom graphics with Jetpack Compose Canvas.
Took MyIGB from zero to Google Play: offline-first MVI + Redux architecture, CI delivering builds to Telegram and Play.
Shipped features in 2 key products on both platforms in close loop with the design team; set up daily CI builds and led the Kotlin migration.
Built features for a mobile localization SDK; raised unit-test coverage to 60%+, published artifacts via GitHub Maven and wrote SDK docs.
Set up the development process with the PM, ran hiring interviews, automated delivery to Fabric Beta.
Kept regular bug-free releases for a video product with 1M+ users; mentored 2 developers and owned a shared codebase for 3 apps.
